verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is a newly launched Delaware-based closed-end investment company.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R11: 'Pershing Square USA, Ltd., a Delaware statutory trust (the “Company”), is a non-diversified, closed-end management investment company'; R3: 'new closed-end fund called Pershing Square USA (PSUS)'; R4: 'Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (“PSUS”), a closed end investment company'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm PSUS as a Delaware statutory trust, closed-end investment company, with IPO context indicating newly launched.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is managed by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (PSCM).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'a closed end investment company to be managed by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (“PSCM”)'; R7: 'a closed end investment company managed by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (“PSCM”)'; R8: 'that will be advised by its investment adviser, PSCM'; R11: 'managed by its investment manager, Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (“PSCM” or the “Manager”)'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in multiple sources confirm PSCM as manager of PSUS.

verifications.claim: Bill Ackman is a key figure in the management of Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R11: 'The Company’s executive officers are: William A. Ackman, Chief Executive Officer'; R2: 'Bill Ackman (CEO)' of PSCM; R3/R9/R10: Bill Ackman as founder/leader launching PSUS IPO
verifications.reasoning: Ackman listed as CEO of PSUS and CEO of its manager PSCM, directly key in management.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) aims to provide a permanent capital model for investing in large-cap, North American-headquartered companies.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'permanent capital model... targeting 12 to 15 undervalued North American-listed companies'; R11: 'acquiring long-term, large minority stakes in 12 to 15 high-quality, predominantly North American-listed, large-capitalization growth companies'; R10: 'invest in 12 to 15 undervalued North American-listed companies'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm permanent capital closed-end structure for large-cap North American companies.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is planning a combined IPO of PSUS shares and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) in 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'the launch of the initial public offering (the “PSUS IPO”) ... and the initial public offering (the “PSI IPO”, and together ... the “Combined IPO”)'; dates in April 2026; R3/R7/R9/R10 similar 'combined IPO' or 'dual IPO' of PSUS and PSI/PS in 2026 context
verifications.reasoning: Multiple announcements confirm combined IPO of PSUS and PSI in 2026.

verifications.claim: The combined IPO of PSUS shares and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) aims to raise up to $10 billion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'seeking an aggregate offering size of at least $5,000,000,000 ... gross proceeds ... in excess of $10,000,000,000'; R3/R7/R9/R10: '$5 billion to $10 billion'
verifications.reasoning: Exact target range stated as up to $10B across sources.

verifications.claim: As of April 2026, PSUS is conducting a dual IPO.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'In April 2026, Pershing Square Capital Management confirmed it had privately raised $2.8 billion ahead of its much-anticipated dual IPO'; R4: dated April 13, 2026 'announces launch'; R9/R10: roadshow April 13, 2026 for dual IPO
verifications.reasoning: Sources dated April 2026 confirm ongoing dual/combined IPO process.

verifications.claim: PSUS plans to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "PSUS".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'both the PSUS Shares and the PSI Shares will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbols “PSUS” and “PS,”'; R7/R8/R9/R10 identical
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of NYSE listing under PSUS symbol.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is designed to be a listed closed-end fund.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'closed end investment company... PSUS Shares ... listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbols “PSUS”'; multiple sources confirm closed-end and NYSE listing
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as closed-end fund planning NYSE listing.

verifications.claim: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) aims to emulate a "Berkshire Hathaway-style" permanent capital structure to reduce redemption risks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'permanent capital model inspired by Warren Buffett... closed-end fund like PSUS, capital becomes stable. Investors cannot redeem shares directly... Berkshire Hathaway-style transformation'
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly describes Berkshire-style permanent capital to avoid redemptions.
